tech_stack.protocol_crates: 12 direct deps (ADR 0006) from merely-made/smolweb: gemini-protocol 0.1.2, scroll-protocol 0.1.0, text-protocol 0.1.0, spartan-protocol 0.1.1, nex-protocol 0.1.1, gopher-protocol 0.1.2, guppy-protocol 0.1.1 (Guppy UDP), scorpion-protocol 0.1.0, kepler-protocol 0.1.0, finger-protocol, dict-protocol, titanite 0.3.2. architecture_snapshot.core_flow: UI (Phase 4) -> Dispatcher::fetch(url) -> Protocol adapter -> PageDoc (normalized across all protocols)
architecture_snapshot.protocol_trait: Protocol: Send+Sync with scheme(), capabilities(), fetch(url, ctx) -> PageDoc, publish(url, payload, ctx) -> PublishResult (default Unsupported)
architecture_snapshot.fetch_context: FetchContext { http_client, cancel: CancellationToken, incognito, policy: FetchPolicy, keychain, store }
architecture_snapshot.dispatcher: Dispatcher { protocols: HashMap<&str, Box<dyn Protocol>> } with register(), fetch(), normalize_address()
architecture_snapshot.adapters: Gemini, Gopher, Finger, Spartan, Nex, Text, Scroll, Molerat, Scorpion, Kepler (fetch), Titan (publish), WebFinger (building block)
architecture_snapshot.pgp_boundary: PGP verification runs on raw response bytes BEFORE any extraction/parsing/rendering (CRITICAL invariant)
architecture_snapshot.titan_gate: Protocol::publish NEVER called from navigation; only Titan upload dialog (Phase 4) calls it

constraints: Single-process Rust. No IPC, no bindings (ADR 0003)
Keychain-only secrets. No plaintext, no Base64 fallback (ADR 0007)
tokio exclusively. No async-std, no smol (ADR 0008)
thiserror for libraries, anyhow for app (ADR 0009)
No webview anywhere except raw-mode HTTP tabs (ADR 0001, 0002)
No unwrap() in library code; unwrap() in tests acceptable
No magic values: use const for limits, timeouts
No SELECT *: explicit column lists in every SQL query
TDD-first: Red (failing test) -> Green (minimal pass) -> Refactor
All checks must pass before commit: cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings, cargo test --workspace, cargo deny check
PGP verification before extraction (CRITICAL invariant, ethics B-09)
Explicit confirmation for irreversible side effects (Titan upload, ethics B-09)
SSRF defense at HTTP layer: every outbound request through FetchPolicy::check_url
conventions: Conventional Commits: feat(phase-2):, fix(phase-2):, test(phase-2):, docs(phase-2):, chore(phase-2):, refactor(phase-2):, perf(phase-2):
Worklog: append to worklog.md (repo root) after every Task ID
Scripts saved to scripts/ before execution (no heredocs)
prior_decisions: Platform webviews via embedded widget; Servo deferred (ADR 0002)
Unit + integration + E2E layers, coverage gates (ADR 0005)
Direct crates.io deps for 10 smolnet protocol crates, pinned in lockfile (ADR 0006)
keyring crate; no plaintext fallback ever (ADR 0007)
thiserror for library errors, anyhow for app-level (ADR 0009)
Conventional commits, GitHub Actions matrix, no --no-verify (ADR 0010)

key_risks: R1: 0.1.0 protocol crates have fundamental API gaps (no TOFU, no cancellation) -> harden in 3.2; wrap in adapter or open upstream PR; drop protocol to 1.1 if unsalvageable
R2: Upstream 0.1.0 crate releases 0.2.0 with breaking changes mid-phase -> handle via dependency-update workflow
R3: Text selection across GTK widgets impossible without custom widget -> spike in 3.11; accept per-block selection for v1 if blocked
R4: Cross-protocol redirect handling edge cases (Gemini -> HTTP) -> documented in FetchPolicy; redirect chain records every hop in DebugInfo
R5: SSRF defense blocks legitimate URLs (localhost for testing) -> FetchPolicy::block_private_network configurable; tests use localhost with flag off
